gbm_population_evidence.quote: Histologically proven GBM (as defined in 2021 WHO Classification of Tumors of the Central Nervous System; Louis, Perry, et al. 2021) that has recurred or progressed, and for which resection is not indicated.

candidate_evidence.quote: to evaluate preliminary efficacy of sonodynamic therapy (SDT) using SONALA-001 and Exablate Type 2.0 device in subjects with progressive or recurrent GBM.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Histologically proven GBM (as defined in 2021 WHO Classification of Tumors of the Central Nervous System; Louis, Perry, et al. 2021) that has recurred or progressed, and for which resection is not indicated.

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: To evaluate the pharmacokinetics (PK) of ALA and Protoporphyrin IX (PpIX) following intravenous (IV) dosing with SONALA-001 by calculating Area Under the plasma Concentration (AUC) vs. time from time 0 to the last measurable time point (AUC-t) (Phase 1)

role_evidence.quote: [COMBINATION_PRODUCT] SONALA-001 (ALA) and MR-Guided Focused Ultrasound device (MRgFUS) (other names: Exablate Type 2.0): SONALA-001(ALA) given 6-12 hours prior to receiving the MRgFUS

agents.drug_class_hint: 5-aminolevulinic acid hydrochloride (SONALA-001), IV; porphyrin precursor sonosensitiser for sonodynamic therapy with MR-guided focused ultrasound

coder_notes: 5-ALA sonodynamic therapy with Exablate MRgFUS: aminolevulinic acid is the candidate with device_dependent true (C12); the device is not listed. Formulation flagged new_route because SONALA-001 is given intravenously (licensed 5-ALA product for glioma visualisation is oral); may be 'none' on adjudication. Cohorts escalate ultrasound energy level, none is a control arm. PK is plasma only (ALA and PpIX), so tumour_pk_planned no. MGMT methylation appears in inclusion only as a description of prior temozolomide therapy, not an entry requirement, so no biomarker row. Gadolinium mentioned only for MRI (not a registered intervention), not listed.
